data.claim: Seven surfaces already take one added file (adapter ports, config_sections modules, event-kind TOML, record-kind TOML, harness TOML, upgrade fragments, declared command families); gates, joins, optimizer inputs, proposals, inbox reasons, doctor/brief/report/metrics sections, approval sites and rules, Config fields and fold HANDLERS are hard-coded and need shared-file edits.
data.falsifier: Adding a throwaway gate, signal, inbox reason, doctor note and proposal kind in a temp package with no edit to any tracked file and seeing them all appear would refute the closed-list claim for that surface.
data.mechanism: Read the code: adapters/registry.py Registry[T] with package/prefix discovery is used by ~20 registries; but GateDef/DEFAULT_GATES (services/gates/defs.py, 16 gates) and the gate-kind inference by fields, status() join = all(settled) over a linear list, optimizer called with ctx={} and fixed-field Candidate, flowsignals.Signals fixed 6 fields, inbox REASONS tuple, metrics VIEWS tuple, doctor's hand-listed notes.extend calls, approvals RULES dict (4) and sites table, Config dataclass fields in config/_core.py, model.HANDLERS (hand-listed) are all closed lists.

data.question: Which of ddflow's extension surfaces (gates, joins, optimizer inputs, proposals, notices, record/event kinds, config, reports, approvals) accept a new feature as ONE added file, and which still need edits to shared files?

data.claim: A single TOML feature manifest (ddflow/features/NAME.toml) whose tables feed per-surface Registry[T] instances (gate plugins, join policies, optimizer providers, proposal kinds, notice kinds, predicates, sections), with code behind Lazy targets and a meta conformance test, covers QA, MR, CHG, TM, RS, AR, PO, LK, WP, WD, TA, PM and HX without special cases.
data.falsifier: A phase feature that needs an edit to a shared file or a new registry beyond the seven proposed after the meta test exists.
data.mechanism: Reuse Registry (duplicate error, sorted discovery, Lazy, loader), tomlcfg overlay for GateDef, core/schedule register_filter/register_key as constraint and cost-term seams, the existing proposal.toml record kind, Tick/Rule/Section shapes; add only contract versioning, isolation and explain.
data.question: What is the smallest generic extension contract so a new feature (gate, join, optimizer provider, proposal kind, notice, section, class) is one added TOML manifest plus lazy code targets, with no shared-file edit?
